candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Invents furigana not on the page: 入(い), a second 郷(ごう), and 従(したが); only the first 郷, 敷 and 和也 carry furigana. Misses the bold ものの in section 4 examples, though bold in sections 5 and 6 is correct. Side tab (ユニット4 ことばと文化) included. Underline on なんてったって and the second blank lines are not shown.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Furigana correct (ごう, し, かずや). Bold ものの and なんといっても correct, but 6② bolds the whole span とても外国人とは思えぬ instead of just とても and ぬ. Only candidate to show the two-line blanks. Adds a 📱 emoji for the icon and ● for the CD marks. Side tab included. No underline on なんてったって.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Furigana correct and all bold accurate, including ものの, なんといっても, とても/ない/ぬ. The dialogue in 5① is restructured into a bullet list, a minor layout deviation. Side tab included. Continuation blank lines and the underline on なんてったって are omitted.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Text and furigana correct. Misses the bold ものの in section 4 and the bold ぬ in 6②. Adds list bullets to the example sentences and bolds the ❶❷ markers. Side tab included. No underline on なんてったって; single blanks only.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Text and furigana correct, but all bold emphasis on the grammar patterns is dropped. The side tab (ユニット4 ことばと文化) is omitted. Adds 🔊 emoji for the CD marks. Horizontal rules approximate the dashed boxes. No underline on なんてったって.

rationale: All five read the main text accurately, so the ranking turns on furigana fidelity, bold emphasis and completeness. C has correct furigana and fully accurate bold, with only a minor restructuring of the dialogue. B is equally complete and best on blank-line layout, but mis-scopes one bold span and adds an emoji. D is accurate but drops the bold on ものの and ぬ. A invents three furigana readings that are not on the page and misses the bold ものの. E is last because it loses all bold emphasis and omits the side tab, though it invents no text.
